scope: All frozen groups in registry; never substitute training/in-domain samples
weights: Record explicit checkpoint path/hash and raw/EMA selection

point_cloud.support: Reference-visible support of the four input views; common deterministic voxel/downsampling settings across methods

confidence_filter.population: All finite depth confidence values across the four input views of each group/method, before filtering
confidence_filter.keep: confidence >= percentile threshold AND valid image region AND finite positive depth AND finite points
confidence_filter.pose_based_alignment: One deterministic Sim3 per group/method, reused at every percentile; no separate threshold-dependent fitting

reference_policy.Hypersim: Measured source depth/cameras on valid unchanged surfaces; source GT invalid on newly inserted static assets
reference_policy.HypersimNegative: Source depth invalid on inserted static assets; use a clearly labeled joint clean DA3 geometry reference for complete clean/static-background support
reference_policy.RealX3D: Dataset-provided COLMAP-derived cameras; joint clean-view DA3 pseudo-GT geometry
reference_policy.RobustNeRF: COLMAP cameras; joint clean-view DA3 pseudo-GT geometry
reference_policy.OnTheGo: Dataset-provided transforms; joint clean extra-view DA3 pseudo-GT geometry

geometry.distance_units: Meters only for metric GT; otherwise record explicit normalized reference-camera-baseline units. F@0.02 in normalized units is not 2cm

decoded_input_rgb.target: Corresponding clean RGB at the same input-view camera, with identical preprocessing; never score restoration against clutter input as clean GT

reference_policy.RealX3D: Paired clean frames from source multigroup manifest; record approximate registration and valid regions
reference_policy.RobustNeRF: Corresponding 0clean capture with explicit camera registration/valid support
reference_policy.OnTheGo: No corresponding clean input GT; PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS are N/A with reason. Keep decoded RGB qualitative outputs; held-out render RGB, if measured, is a separate metric

decoded_input_rgb.missing_reference: N/A with explicit reason; never zero or silently skip

per_group: point cloud P20/P40/P50 qualitative comparisons and colored PLYs
artifacts.aggregation: Equal group means within each scene, equal scene means within each dataset; report counts, missing-reference counts, and coverage

mask_prediction: Keep mask-head probability/binary qualitative outputs when enabled; additive to required geometry/RGB evaluation
execution_status: Default evaluation contract fixed; legacy fixed_suite_training_eval currently implements pose and partial RGB only. Full contract requires extending runner; do not label partial output as complete evaluation.
